summary: We developed an enlightening digital story telling the story of the Kepler Space Telescope. Our project translates Kepler's historic journey, from discovering thousands of exoplanets and Earth-sized worlds to paving the way for modern observatories like the James Webb Space Telescope, into an inspiring story. By highlighting how Kepler's archived data continues to spark new discoveries even after its retirement, our project addresses the challenge of connecting complex space science with human curiosity. Ultimately, it is important because Kepler forever transformed our view of the night sky, proving that planets outnumber stars and inspiring future generations to keep asking if we are alone in the universe.
details: Our project introduces the story of Kepler to any person interested in such space stories. We hope our story enlightens the reader about said telescopes revolutionary legacy. We combined our fundamental creativity with some help from super intelligence and brought the reader an educational story about the Kepler Space Telescope.
